What’s next

You’re already welcome here—this sketches direction, not deadlines for your soul.

A quiet roadmap for people who want to know where the site is headed without turning it into a noisy product feed.

This page stays simple on purpose: what is live now, what is next, and what may come later if it still protects the site’s privacy-first, Scripture-first heart.

Already live

  • Ministry reframe (May 2026): Today’s Daily Battle is now operating clearly as a Bible-teaching ministry—equipping people to know the KJV and steward the gifts God gave them. Transparent support allocation updated to reflect this, including honest disclosure of builder time per 1 Timothy 5:18.
  • Steady Shepherd Reflections: First reflection live on the pastor hub—personal, KJV-anchored, written from real experience.
  • Sermon Builder handout: One-click Print Handout button on the Sermon Builder generates a clean, printable one-pager.
  • Quiet night, calm cream, and dawn parchment appearance modes, plus higher contrast and larger text.
  • Offline-first reading, prayer, battle plans, memorize tools, and installable PWA paths.
  • Family hub, printables, battle plans, My Study, and gentle memorize rhythm.
  • Public media copy, founder story, and clearer support/transparency pages.
  • Printable Pack Generator with Anxiety Anchor, Bedtime Peace for Littles, and Grief Comfort bundles.
  • Embeddable Verse Widgets with the same KJV breakdown language used across the main site.

Now

  • Keep the custom-domain header/security alignment clean so live behavior matches the repo and verification stays honest.
  • Grow embeddable widgets from starter cards into more hosted presets for churches, families, and counseling pages.
  • Keep printable and share surfaces tied to the same breakdown runtime so copy stays calm instead of drifting by feature.

Next

  • Prayer Wall 2.0 in safe steps: queued shared prayers that can actually flush, clearer private-vs-shared guidance, gentle KJV verse echoes, and household-room groundwork that stays local-first.
  • Focused browser and live checks around the prayer wall changes instead of broad noisy test sprawl.
  • A steadier export/restore path around family and prayer data so private flows remain understandable.

Later, if it still fits the mission

  • On-device recommendations, but only after widgets and prayer sharing settle; the likely path is local heuristics or a restrained hybrid, never robotic pushing.
  • Broader language coverage for topic pages, plans, and key study helps.
  • Richer calm-audio options, as long as they remain optional, local-first where possible, and never become a gimmick.

Release Order

  1. Header alignment and live verification discipline.
  2. Embeddable widgets and hosted copy surface.
  3. Prayer Wall 2.0, starting with the least risky local-first pieces.
  4. Deferred recommendation work and broader growth surfaces only after the earlier sharing layers feel quiet and solid.

Verification Gates

  • Static checks for new pages, service-worker precache coverage, and live marker coverage.
  • Focused browser checks for the embed widget surface and for prayer-wall queue and echo behavior.
  • Pages deployment URL checks versus custom-domain checks any time deploy behavior is in doubt.

What will not change

No ads. No guilt-heavy gamification. No AI-generated filler. No pressure-first growth tricks. The site should keep feeling like a quiet place for real battles, not a dashboard that performs at you.

If you want to help move the roadmap forward, the calmest way is still the same: support this quiet place, or share the page that helped you.
